arcNotes.nativeIsAliased: On Arc the native coin and the USDC ERC-20 at 0x3600...0000 are two views of ONE balance (18 vs 6 decimals). setNativeAliasToken was therefore called with that ERC-20, which closes the native path everywhere: address(0) can no longer be allowlisted for payments, nor withdrawn/swept/recovered. All value moves through the 6-decimal ERC-20 view, keeping amounts identical to every other chain (Solana/Stellar/Arbitrum) so the backend and mobile app need no Arc-specific handling.
arcNotes.aliasingVerifiedOnChain: After the smoke test the proxy held balanceOf=2000000 (6d) and address(this).balance=2000000000000000000 (18d) simultaneously — 2e18/1e12 == 2e6, the same money seen twice.
arcNotes.gasIsUsdc: Gas is paid in native USDC from the sender's own balance, which is the same pot as their payment balance. Clients must leave headroom for gas rather than offering a MAX-out-the-balance payment.
arcNotes.forkTestingUnavailable: `forge test --fork-url` cannot exercise Arc's USDC: transfers revert with empty returndata because the precompile backing 0x3600...0000 does not exist in revm. Reads (balanceOf) work, writes do not. Integration testing must run live against testnet.

verifiedEndToEnd.note: Every entrypoint exercised live against Arc testnet with real USDC, not a mock.

processMerchantPayment.note: EIP-712 quote signed with the API's real EVM_QUOTE_SIGNER_PRIVATE_KEY and verified on-chain against backendSigner. Domain separator 0x51a1bf32df37d3acacfe1441787baef16c83dace0f9c8ab267b17af3c4b6f3dd (chainId 5042002).

verifiedEndToEnd.nativePathRejected: withdraw / recoverToken / queueWithdrawal with address(0) all revert NativeDisabledOnAliasChain (0x9016e99f); addAllowedPaymentToken(address(0)) likewise. sweepMerchantBacking hits its InsufficientBalance precheck first but is guarded the same way.
